t: Unlocking a reuse revolution to tackle the plastic crisis - SYSTEMIQ
s: November 22, 2023 - Systemiq led the analysis of the economic and environmental performance of single-use packaging and their reusable alternatives for selected beverage, food cupboard, personal care, and fresh food items. The study shows that, in the most ambitious scenario, returnable plastic packaging could reduce greenhouse gas emissions and water use by 35% to 70% compared to single-use plastics. ... Sander Defruyt, Plastics Initiative Lead at the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, advocates for a “reuse revolution,” highlighting its potential to combat plastic pollution, conserve natural resources, and make strides towards a net-zero future.
